verdict.rationale: AMD's GAIA framework docs state that local inference on Ryzen AI hardware 'keeps your data private' and supports air-gapped deployment, implying data never leaves the device and thus can't be harvested for training. However, there is no explicit statement, policy, or control specifically addressing prevention of data being used to train AI models (e.g., no opt-out toggle, no data-use policy documentation for cloud telemetry or model updates). missing for 10: explicit data-training opt-out policy, telemetry/data-collection disclosure, first-party privacy policy statement, independent verification that no data leaves device.
